stats-primary-secondary.title: Stats Primary Secondary

stats-growth-timeline.title: Stats Growth Timeline

stats-circular-progress.title: Stats Circular Progress

stats-card-group.title: Stats Card Group
stats-card-group.importantUsageNotes: Ensure to generate exactly 3 'stats' since the stats element is a 3-column card layout. stats-animated-counter.title: Stats Animated Counter
stats-animated-counter.importantUsageNotes: Ensure to generate exactly 4 'stats' since the stats element is a 4-column animated counter layout. stats-number-ticker.title: Stats Number Ticker

stats-milestone-sidebar.title: Stats Milestone Sidebar

stats-bar-comparison.title: Stats Bar Comparison

about-company-profile.title: About Company Profile

about-developer-profile.title: About Developer Profile

about-developer-story.title: About Developer Story

about-interactive-tabs.title: About Interactive Tabs

about-location-info-hero.title: About Location Info Hero

about-mission-dual-image.title: About Mission Dual Image

about-startup-team.title: About Startup Team

about-stats-showcase.title: About Stats Showcase

about-story-expertise.title: About Story Expertise

about-story-gallery.title: About Story Gallery

about-story-hero.title: About Story Hero

blog-cards-read-time.title: Blog Cards Read Time

blog-cards-tagline-cta.title: Blog Cards Tagline CTA

blog-carousel-apple.title: Blog Carousel Apple

blog-category-overlay.title: Blog Category Overlay
blog-category-overlay.importantUsageNotes: Ensure to generate exactly 6 'posts' since the layout is a 3-column × 2-row overlay-image grid. Only use real blog posts from the site's content; do not invent titles, categories, or dates. Follow the example props closely for this block.

blog-featured-popular.title: Blog Featured Popular

blog-grid-author-cards.title: Blog Grid Author Cards

blog-grid-nine-posts.title: Blog Grid Nine Posts

blog-horizontal-cards.title: Blog Horizontal Cards

blog-horizontal-timeline.title: Blog Horizontal Timeline

blog-related-articles.title: Blog Related Articles
blog-related-articles.importantUsageNotes: Ensure to generate exactly 4 items in the 'articles' array since the layout is a 4-column related-articles row. blog-tech-insights.title: Blog Tech Insights

carousel-feature-badge.title: Carousel Feature Badge

carousel-fullscreen-scroll-fx.title: Carousel Fullscreen Scroll FX

carousel-horizontal-cards.title: Carousel Horizontal Cards

carousel-image-hero.title: Carousel Image Hero

carousel-portfolio-hero.title: Carousel Portfolio Hero

carousel-progress-slider.title: Carousel Progress Slider

feature-split-image.title: Feature Split Image
